title: Ben Bernanke
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Official announcement from Anthropic: Ben Bernanke
body:
Anthropic announced that former Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke has joined its Long‑Term Benefit Trust (LTBT), an independent body tasked with overseeing the company’s commitment to develop advanced AI for the long‑term good of humanity. Bernanke, a Nobel‑laureate economist known for his leadership during the 2008 financial crisis and his scholarly work on the Great Depression, brings deep expertise in macro‑economic stability and crisis response to the trust.

The LTBT operates separately from Anthropic’s management and investors; its trustees hold no equity, receive no profit share, and are compensated only for their time. They provide guidance to the board and leadership on high‑stakes decisions, especially those concerning AI’s societal risks and long‑term impacts. By appointing members with diverse backgrounds in policy, security, law, and economics, the trust aims to create a checks‑and‑balances mechanism that aligns commercial AI development with broader public welfare.

For developers and researchers, Bernanke’s addition signals a stronger focus on understanding how AI will reshape labor markets, productivity, and global economies. His experience in steering large‑scale economic systems offers valuable insight for anticipating downstream effects of AI models, helping the community build safer, more responsible technologies while informing policy discussions that will shape the future of AI deployment.
